name: Ramp
text:
Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that appears immediately on keyboard navigation.

This ensures every interactive element is visible to keyboard users without delay, meeting WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 (Focus Visible). The trade-off is slightly reduced visual harmony for mouse users, but keyboard accessibility is non-negotiable for inclusive design.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast focus ring still forces sighted keyboard users to navigate visually, potentially leading to distractions or confusion amid other design elements. A better alternative is to implement a focus ring that dynamically adjusts its contrast based on the surrounding colors, maintaining visual harmony while ensuring focus visibility. To settle this argument, conduct user testing with keyboard navigation to assess both visibility and aesthetic appeal, gathering feedback from diverse users.
